# Categories Requirements Checklist: Categories (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 007 — offline-first own categories, read-only defaults and references, the category choice/display contract for C6, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): offline/sync correctness, contract fidelity and the C6-facing choice/display rules; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec in the same session; each says where.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the ordering of the Archived section specified, not only of active own categories? [Gap → fixed: FR-002 "active and archived, ordered by name"]
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified whether an archived but unused category can still be deleted? [Gap → fixed: FR-016 "active or archived"]
- [x] CHK003 Is the behaviour defined when the category choice has nothing to offer for a kind? [Gap → fixed: Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Are loading, empty-own, defaults-missing and refresh-failure states of the categories screen each specified and distinguishable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, US1-S8, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the refusal reasons and the actions offered for each (edit, try again, discard, archive instead, keep) enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the removal of a wallet's category references specified for every way a wallet can leave the phone (deleted, access lost, not found)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the fate of an own category with an unknown kind specified for the views, the choice and the display? [Completeness, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is the 50-character name limit defined in the same unit the server counts? [Gap → fixed: FR-006 "Unicode code points"]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "not known to be used" for offering Delete defined precisely (server flag plus unsent local uses)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the refresh cadence of a wallet's references quantified (on demand, at most once a minute per wallet)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Clarification 5]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the icon and colour sets named, and is "none" defined for both? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Clarification 3]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it unambiguous which name a default shows in each app language, and that partner names are never translated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do FR-015 ("archived never offered") and FR-018 ("current category stays listed") agree? [Conflict → fixed: FR-015 now names the exception]
- [ ] CHK014 Do US3-S3, FR-016 and FR-017 agree on when Delete is hidden and when it returns? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the resolution order in FR-019 and the backend's transactions.yaml `category_id` description match exactly? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Sources]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the kind rule consistent across US2-S3, FR-008 and the invariants table? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Can SC-004 (language switch renames 100% of defaults in under 1 s offline) be measured without C6? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-006 objectively checkable given the placeholder rule? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK019 Is SC-007's dependency on C6 stated where it is checked? [Acceptance, Spec §SC-007, §8]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are recovery flows covered for each clash kind (edit vs live, delete vs live, anything vs deleted)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the in-use refusal arriving for a deletion queued offline covered end to end, including what happens to Delete afterwards? [Coverage, US3-S6, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the partner-category path (shown, not choosable, kept as current) covered by scenarios? [Coverage, US4-S4]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Is a default category retired after use covered for both the views and the display? [Edge Case, US1-S3, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is an empty (unseeded) default set on the server covered? [Edge Case, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the category open in the editor disappearing (refresh) covered with and without a waiting change? [Edge Case, Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 Are the glossary's banned synonyms for Category stated for code and copy in both languages? [NFR/P-01, Spec §FR-024]
